notes.title: Legendary Hoplite | Available Now
notes.content:
[h2][b]The Time has Come![/b][/h2]

People of Ithaca, the monstrous horde of mythological creatures have arrived, now pick up your arms, ready your mind and body for a fight, and perform heroic deeds, all in the defense of our fair city. Return to us with your shield, or upon it!

[h3]That's right everyone, [b]Legendary Hoplite[/b] has become available for everyone![/h3]

[previewyoutube=5OqdXR6X6AM;full][/previewyoutube]

The time for playtests and prologues is over, now is the time for you to dive into the full world of [b]Legendary Hoplite[/b], pitting you against an undead horde, mythological creatures, and terrifyingly powerful bosses.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1479810/Legendary_Hoplite

[h1][b]IMPORTANT![/b][/h1]
We started with just 3 people, initially aiming to create a mobile game, but we soon decided that our game would be best suited for PC. Your reviews are crucial to us - don't forget to leave it because based on your review (really hoping you'll enjoy the game!), we'll be working on its improvements! Thank you in advance!

[h1][b]The Game[/b][/h1][h2][b] 💥 Rally the defenses of Ithaca[/b][/h2]
8 powerful army units available to you. From the powerful phalanx, to master archers, mysterious witches, and more.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/7d4221687226051ac03887028cee7857bb2544b0.gif[/img]

[h2][b]🎶 Enchanting New Music[/b][/h2]
A legendary game needs legendary music, and we've got exactly that. Composed by the one and only Sakis Tolis, every boss fight has a special soundtrack, so make sure to complete the game to hear them all!

[previewyoutube=larw5zVXtJk;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=larw5zVXtJk[/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]⚔️ Tower Defense meets Action RPG![/b][/h2]
Fight your way through 3 chapters, 39 battlefields, upgrade your character, your armies, and equip gear forged by the gods!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/79ee1da580fe3b9256805ed187e2a04182558bf9.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Legendary Hoplite - Should I Play it?[/b][/h1]
Our approach to [b]Legendary Hoplite[/b] gives the tower defense genre a unique twist. By mixing in features typically found in action RPG's and leaning heavily on the rich Greek mythology, even the most experienced tower defense master will find something new to enjoy.

But, don't just take our word for it:[list]
[*] [i]While it revisits the well-trodden path of Greek heroism, the marriage of A-RPG and tower defense mechanics freshens up the genre in exciting ways[/i] - rpggamers.com
[*] [i]Legendary Hoplite, its unique art and mix of gameplay elements are a fresh take on the Tower Defense genre. The art of the enemies is so well done I loved every enemy encounter[/i] - Bgeek.eu
[/list]
[h1][b]Legendary Hoplite Soundtrack[/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2789660/Legendary_Hoplite_Soundtrack

As part of this DLC, you’ll also receive the game’s music/soundtrack, so you can listen to your favorite tracks on the game. 
[b][i]Important:[/i][/b] The tracks by Sakis Tolis are not included.

[h1][b]SUPPORT ITHACA BUNDLE[/b][/h1]
We have teamed up with [url=https://www.ithacabirmingham.com]Ithaca Birmingham[/url] to support their cause to educate the public on Greek culture, language, history, and art! A portion of all sales from the soundtrack will go to Ithaca Birmingham! Want to learn more about them? Read what we wrote in our initial announcement [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1479810/view/3987442273051384407 ]here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/a4c8645dafea5bc1469282cd845398bbcd4711e1.png[/img]

[h1][b]GAME BUNDLES[/b][/h1]
[b][h2]Mythical Heroes Bundle[/h2][/b]What if Commander Dio met Achilles, and they fought together on the same side? What if that happened? No one knows; it's both possible and not!

notes.title: DevLog #8: Mercenaries, Sets and Loot
notes.content:
Chaírete, hoplites!

Today you will learn about mercenaries, weapons and how you get those weapons!

Let’s start…

[h2]Mercenaries[/h2]
Mercenaries are simple folk - you pay them and they work for you. In the realities of Legendary Hoplite this means that you use your Combat Points to make them perform an action during combat. What actions can they do? Multiple: clean up obstacles, buff allies, debuff enemies, set traps, etc. 
Different levels of chapters usually have corresponding mercenaries related to the plot and environment. For example, in Chapter 1 we have a grave digger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/e6e27dba393350766bbb6670ba20f4c39f03f9fe.png[/img]

What will a gravedigger do? He will dig up graves on the cemetery map and this will prevent ghosts from spawning. This is especially useful against Cerberus, who can summon ghosts from the graves. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/0cecc813e8d17ce038b3c7e7a946a3c182f93454.png[/img]

[h2]Arcana and more Legendaries[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/2470d9f7e14ca6e08f72437556311e89003521f4.png[/img]

Arcana are special set items. When a player has 2 or more items from the same set, they will receive a special effect of that Arcana. They will also have their own unique animations.

One of the sets consists of [b]Dragon Tail[/b] (spear), [b]Dragon Tooth[/b] (sword), [b]Underworld’s Rift[/b] (shield) and [b]Underworld’s Darkness[/b] (helm). Shield allows you to turn enemies into skeletons, spear increases damage from all sources to the enemies hit by it, but we won’t tell you what helm and sword do. But we will tell you what some of the set bonuses do. For example, when you have 3 pieces of this set you will spawn an [b]allied skeleton[/b] each time you kill an enemy and a chance to spawn a [b]skeleton archer[/b] alongside it. And 4 pieces give all your skeletons poison attacks, give a chance to spawn two skeleton archers instead of one and allows you to summon a Colchian Dragon! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/41dcd6240888dc15cc88b3293183948d57d3f124.png[/img]

We also want to share a couple of new legendary weapons.
[b]Cronus’s Harpe[/b] sword allows you to designate an area where time stops. It affects both allies and enemies, but enemies will take more damage while they are under this effect. And if you kill an enemy with a melee attack there is a chance that this will reduce the cooldown of spells.
[b]Frozen Heart[/b] shield  sends a sphere of cold - with ice spikes around it - dealing damage and slowing enemies hit. When the sphere reaches location - it explodes dealing damage and applying a slow effect on all the enemies nearby. And with enough enemies in front of Dio, Frozen Heart will attack them with ice spikes, dealing damage and slowing them.

[h2]Drop system[/h2]

The system is quite simple, really, as it consists of two components: [b]Blood system[/b] and [b]General system[/b].

[b]Blood system[/b] guarantees a [b]100% drop chance[/b], but you will only receive loot (items or coins) from it after killing a new type of enemy for the first time in combat. Each time you encounter a new enemy, you'll receive loot, allowing you to have a variety of choices for equipment.

On the other hand, [b]General system[/b] affects all enemies and provides you with a chance to obtain an item from every kill. However, the drop chance is much lower compared to the Blood system. Additionally, the General system does not have a predetermined quality or type. It randomly determines various attributes (type, stats, skill, etc.) once it confirms that you should receive an item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/dc7af155f9737a1c035d39456c9f5b7572c5f5d8.png[/img]


And this is it for today! Hope that you will join us for the next devlog - we have even more interesting things to share!

And don't forget to wishlist Legendary Hoplite: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1479810/Legendary_Hoplite

notes.title: DevLog: Ajax’s Trial Results
notes.content:
Chaírete, hoplites!

First, we want to thank you for playing [b]Legendary Hoplite: Ajax’s Trial[/b] and discussing it. Your feedback will help shape the game and make it even better.

This is why we want to talk about your feedback and tell you what the future holds. Let’s start!

There were discussions that some passive skills are stronger than others. And, yes, some passives might feel stronger - in a short campaign. This is just a prologue, just one chapter - you’ve seen a small part of what the game can offer. While the Ajax’s Trial version may have limited content and relatively easy difficulty, we can assure you that the passive skills that provide non-damaging effects are just as valuable as those that deal damage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087671/997bf4b8ed5b6e814d6f5e7179ccb8441fb19f1e.jpg[/img]
[i]Who wouldn’t want more starting points?[/i]

We have carefully designed the passive skills to be versatile and effective against various enemies and situations, which can further enhance the player's character and army build. For instance, if troops are upgraded to higher levels, our reliable wooden fences will get thorns. Those thorns will damage enemies and apply bleeding effects. And stone walls disarm enemies that hit them and, upon collapsing, deal huge damage upon those unfortunate who destroyed them. Or, as another example, the "Arc Slash" skill allows the hero to attack enemies that have already passed him, which is especially helpful against spiders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087671/a9d859bd12c39c5bc966f89275c7f30dd977490b.png[/img]

Some players pointed out that the UI and visual clarity of the game could use a bit of improvement. And we can assure you - in the final version, we will improve the visuals and user interface. 
One of the comments regarding UI was about comparing weapons. Please, consider this: there will be a lot of different weapon options that support different playstyles. Sometimes you will have to choose from different item levels or the different quality to push onward. Clear indication which weapon is “better” might halt progression at some point.

We also saw some requests that asked us to allow placing structures and soldiers in a row just in front Dio. Unfortunately, we can’t do this for two reasons:
First, gameplay. This row is used for Dio to perform Minion summoning skills and other actions.
Second, visual. With so many units and with all the rows filled it might feel really cramped. And it will also look like Dio is hitting his own allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087671/904c824ea9479dc1e6523a9ab88c213a5c458cab.jpg[/img]
[i]It already looks a bit cramped with just two towers and a palisade[/i]

Our plans also include adding gamepad control and adding Steam Deck support - so you will be able to play the way you prefer!

Other than that we can assure you that we are working on every bug that was reported. And if you face some technical issue - you can always tell us about it on our Discord server.

And this is it for now. A small force of Cyclops approaches Ithaca and it is time to put on a helmet, grab a spear and defend Ithaca once again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087671/4d76a60a9431ec62cc80391fc2febfacb0c87b6c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix #2 | Further Improvements and Changes
notes.content:
Hail, valiant Hoplites! 

Your love and support for [b]Legendary Hoplite: Ajax's Trial[/b] have left us awe-inspired. Each one of you is an epic hero in our realm! We've tirelessly toiled to make the game even more legendary, and now, we bring you thrilling updates. 

Brace yourselves for what lies ahead!

[b]General Changes[/b]
[list][*] Ajax's indomitable spirit shines once again as his HP is restored to its mighty glory of 8800, ensuring he stands strong amidst the trials.[/list]

[b]Character Enhancements[/b]
[list][*] Level 3 has been bestowed with an additional spear, a formidable three-way spear. Beware, it does not include the imbalanced Pew Pew Spear, for we seek equilibrium on the battlefield.[/list]

[b]Item Enrichments[/b]
[list][*] Ajax's fabled "Legendary Sword" now wields even greater power, dealing 2 points of devastation. Moreover, this extraordinary blade bestows a bountiful bonus of 1000 Coins, an increase from the previous 450 Coins.[/list]

[b]Monstrous Transformations[/b]
[list][*] The Spider's covetousness is tempered, and thus their defeated carcasses yield a reduced reward of 250 Coins. The spoils of victory now align with their arachnid challenge.
[*] Ascending the ranks of Sheep Level demands greater tribute, as the Coin requirement has been raised to 1000 Coins. Triumph over this heightened threshold for truly gratifying achievements.
[*] The marker, an emblem of your progress, now dances amidst the Spiders, guiding your path toward conquering their arachnid menace.[/list]

[b]Bug Banishment[/b]
[list][*] Vanquished is the dire bug that plagued new game crashes. With this new build, a stable and exhilarating gameplay experience awaits your unwavering presence.[/list]

We are indebted to your unwavering support and invaluable feedback that aids us in shaping a grander game. Embrace the cascading waves of balance and embark upon an epic journey through the realms of [b]Legendary Hoplite: Ajax's Trial[/b]!

We are thrilled to announce the upcoming release of [b]Legendary Hoplite: Ajax's Trial[/b], a unique experience that delves into the realms of ancient battles in the island of Ithaca. Brace yourself for a riveting experience that will test your strategic skills and immerse you in a fantasy like no other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/96617027e0983e0db7508a27c3bec93816311127.jpg[/img]

Get in the shoes of [b]Dio[/b], prepare to save your citizens and beat the one and only Ajax. Unleash your might and valor as you slash through mythical monsters in a series of captivating levels. Engage in intense combat, wielding your weapons with precision and strategic powers to overcome the relentless adversaries standing in your path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/19d5e4cf40e7a71ae6f4a051addf3998ef65dc9a.jpg[/img]

This new version offers a taste of the full game, featuring a selection of levels that will immerse you in the heart of the ongoing conflict. To test your courage, master powerful abilities, and face off against these legendary creatures in intense, strategic combat. 

But that's not all! 

As you embark on this perilous journey, you will also encounter two bonus levels that are for you to explore 🐑. These hidden challenges will put your skills to the ultimate test and offer a glimpse into the untold depths of the Legendary Hoplite world.

So, wishlist now and stay tuned for the date!

About Legendary Hoplite[/h3]

A combination of Action RPG and Tower Defense: slay monsters, find weapons, upgrade your armies, defend your base… Prevent humanity from extinction at the hands of monsters from Greek mythology and ancient tribes. Don't let them cross the gate, commander!
Stay tuned for the release date to take your place on the battlefield, where the clash of steel and the roar and become a Hero!
